title: Palantir Launches 'Sovereign Stack' to Give Companies Control of AI Infrastructure

tickers.name: Palantir Technologies Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The software firm unveiled a new suite of tools at its latest developer conference to let businesses manage their artificial intelligence operations without relying on outside providers. The sovereign stack, as the company calls it, provides a combination of compute infrastructure, agent stacks, and evaluation primitives designed to give organizations complete control over their AI pipeline.

Launched at DevCon 7, the toolkit includes fine-tuned models that Palantir says can beat frontier performance levels. The company framed the move as a shift toward corporate autonomy, claiming the infrastructure allows organizations to own the value they create rather than "renting" intelligence from third parties.
